description: Sector breakdown of all discovered entities across your tracked accounts. Shows distribution with counts and percentages. Also returns taxonomy: industries with sub-industries, AI types and buyers with counts - the exact values frontrun_search takes as industry / sub / ai / buyer.

scope.description: Whose follows to read: "tracked" (default, your tracked accounts), "network" (the whole Frontrun network, paid Pro plans) or "list:<id>" (one of your lists from frontrun_lists, with its sectors).

name: frontrun_sectors
